title: 神经符号驱动：基于规则的可信推理用于驾驶VLA
summary: 提出神经符号驱动框架，利用经典规则规划器的规则基础推理轨迹监督驾驶VLA模型，确保推理与运动生成因果耦合。在模拟器基准上，三摄像头感知下ADE@3s从0.47降至0.26，失效率从8.30%降至6.40%。
summary_en: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a framework that supervises driving VLAs with rule-grounded reasoning traces from classical rule-based planners, ensuring reasoning is causally coupled to motion generation. On a simulator benchmark, ADE@3s drops from 0.47 to 0.26 and miss rate from 8.30% to 6.40% under three-camera perception.
